uyg.altbaslik: Scientific crime analysis — Question → Plan → Verdict
uyg.atolye_aciklama: Node editor (DataFlow successor): exploration and preview; evidence-producing nodes run on the server
uyg.dil_modeli_kapali: Language model: off (the flow works fully)
uyg.olasilik_yok: Categories are not probabilities; the verdict is relative to the listed rivals.
soru.metin_ornek: e.g. Did burglaries increase in the last 12 months?
soru.oneri_yok: No type could be suggested; choose below
soru.onaylayan_not: In a confirmatory study the hypothesis set and parameters are locked under this name BEFORE the data is seen.
soru.veri_yok: No files in the data root — upload a CSV
soru.kesildi: Warning: the file was truncated at the row limit
soru.parametreler: Parameters (chosen before analysis; part of the lock)
plan.rakipler: Rival explanations and their discriminating tests
plan.bilinmeyen: H_unknown: unlisted explanations always remain open; the verdict is only relative to the listed rivals.
plan.serbest_baslik: Add a rival explanation (before the data)
plan.serbest_not: A free-text rival cannot be tested by the machine: it stays 'unresolved' and the verdict is at most FRAGILE.
plan.kilit_not: Confirmatory study: the protocol will be locked under {kisi} before the data is examined.
plan.veri_secilmedi: Choose data on the Question screen first
hukum.taslak: DRAFT — becomes a RESULT only with human approval
hukum.gerekce_dil_notu: Reasoning sentences are produced by the core in Turkish.
hukum.ifade_kategori: Relative to the listed rivals, the primary hypothesis is: {kategori}.
sinama.serbest: Not machine-testable in v1 (no free-form prediction language)
sinama.R-RASTLANTI: significance test of the primary prediction (multiple-testing corrected)
sinama.R-BILDIRIM: is the increase also seen in channels present throughout the period
sinama.R-MEVSIM: paired comparison of the same calendar months, last 12 vs previous 12
sinama.R-VERI: field validity and heaping checks for the question type
sinama.R-TESADUF-YAKINLIK: agreement of the MO evidence line with the space-time line
sinama.R-ESZAMANLI: ratio-of-rate-ratios against a control area (difference in differences)
sinama.R-ORTALAMAYA-DONUS: last 3 pre-intervention months vs earlier baseline (relative to control if any)
sinama.R-YER-DEGISTIRME: ratio-of-rate-ratios of the buffer area against control
sonraki.R-RASTLANTI: a longer period or more records (power)
sonraki.R-BILDIRIM: a reporting channel/source field in the records
sonraki.R-MEVSIM: at least 24 months of data (same months compared across years)
sonraki.R-PAYDA: population or number of targets at risk per area/cell
sonraki.R-VERI: data cleaning and an account of the invalid records' origin
sonraki.R-TESADUF-YAKINLIK: physical/digital traces or witness information (human review)
sonraki.R-ESZAMANLI: data from a comparable control area
sonraki.R-YER-DEGISTIRME: data from the buffer area surrounding the intervention area
hipotez.ARTIS: the increase in recorded incidents reflects a real increase in crime
hipotez.YOGUNLASMA: incidents are spatially more concentrated than random (hot spot)
hipotez.ETKI: the intervention reduced incidents in the intervention area (relative to the control area; without control, interrupted time series)
hipotez.SERI: some of these incidents show a pattern from a common source (series) — a pattern, not a claim of identity or the same offender
ongoru.YOGUNLASMA: at least one hot cell (Gi*, Benjamini–Hochberg q ≤ 0.05)
ongoru.ETKI: log ratio-of-rate-ratios z ≤ −1.96 (no control: upper CI bound of the ITS level change < 0)
ongoru.SERI: at least one 'strong' candidate (distinctive MO + space-time, FDR)
yanlislama.YOGUNLASMA: undefined in v1: finding no hot spot only means 'not supported'
yanlislama.ETKI: a significant INCREASE in the intervention area relative to control
yanlislama.SERI: undefined in v1: finding no candidate only means 'not supported'
hukum.sade_not: Language model summary — not binding; the verdict is the one above.
soru_turu.SERI: SERIES — do incidents share a source (pattern ≠ offender)?
soru_turu.ETKI: IMPACT — did an intervention reduce incidents?
rakip.R-RASTLANTI: Random fluctuation / small numbers / multiple comparisons
rakip.R-YER-DEGISTIRME: Displacement (crime moving to a nearby area)
kural.K1-zincir: Evidence chain could not be verified → ABSTAIN
kural.K1-sinanamadi: Primary prediction could not be tested → ABSTAIN
kural.K3-rakip: A high-impact rival is supported → INCONCLUSIVE
kural.K4-kirilgan: Unresolved rival or robustness warning → FRAGILE
kural.K5-destek: Prediction held, every rival excluded → SUPPORTED
kural.T1-onkayit: Ceiling: no valid pre-registration (lock) → at most FRAGILE
kural.T1-amac: Ceiling: exploratory/operational study → at most FRAGILE
kural.T2-seri: Ceiling: SERIES at most FRAGILE (pattern ≠ offender)
